description: For a natural base b at least two and a natural m, the hereditary base expansion is canonical, has value m, is a hereditary Cantor normal form, and is the unique canonical expression with value m.
signature:
Lemmatheca.SetTheory.NormalFunctions.hereditary_spec (b m : ℕ) (hb : 2 ≤ b) :
  Lemmatheca.SetTheory.NormalFunctions.Canonical b (Lemmatheca.SetTheory.NormalFunctions.hereditary b m) ∧
    Lemmatheca.SetTheory.NormalFunctions.evalNat b (Lemmatheca.SetTheory.NormalFunctions.hereditary b m) = m ∧
      (Lemmatheca.SetTheory.NormalFunctions.hereditary b m).NF ∧
        ∀ (t : ONote),
          Lemmatheca.SetTheory.NormalFunctions.Canonical b t →
            Lemmatheca.SetTheory.NormalFunctions.evalNat b t = m →
              t = Lemmatheca.SetTheory.NormalFunctions.hereditary b m
